import html # Predefined HTML template for a blog post. # {title} and {body} will be replaced with the sanitized content. BLOG_FORMAT = """ {title}

{title}

{body}
""" def render_article_page(headline: str, content: str) -> str: """ Format and sanitize a blog post for safe HTML display. Parameters ---------- headline : str The title of the blog post. content : str The full body text of the blog post. Returns ------- str A fully rendered HTML page with the title and content safely escaped. """ # Escape any potentially dangerous characters to prevent XSS attacks. safe_title = html.escape(headline, quote=True) safe_content = html.escape(content, quote=True) # Render the final HTML using the template. rendered_html = BLOG_FORMAT.format(title=safe_title, body=safe_content) return rendered_html
